sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the investigation has been concluded and final form has been submitted without proper investigation.

4. This application is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to approach the Superintendent of Police, Saran at Chapra with his representation/application for further investigation of the case in light of the materials which are available on record and because the case has not been properly investigated by the I.O. of the case.

5. If such a representation/application is filed before the Superintendent of Police, Saran at Chapra,
he will consider the same and if he finds sufficient grounds for further investigation, he will order for the same in accordance with the law.
